messages:
Priya (Velvet CS): Hey team, onboarding spike for customer Velvet — their browser integration is getting lots of 429s during initial setup. Root logs show a flood of OPTIONS preflights followed by POSTs, looks like a fanout from many tabs/workers. Any quick mitigation?
Alex (CS): Can you paste a short snippet of the logs and which SDK/version they're using? Also: is this behind a proxy/CDN?
Priya (Velvet CS): Logs (truncated):
```
[10:15:22] OPTIONS /v1/chat 200 OK
[10:15:22] POST /v1/chat 429 Too Many Requests
[10:15:22] OPTIONS /v1/chat 200 OK
[10:15:22] POST /v1/chat 429 Too Many Requests
... many concurrent OPTIONS from same client IPs, then bursts of POSTs
```
Using web SDK v0.9.4, hosted via customer proxy -> our edge. They reproduce locally by opening 6 tabs.
Tara (SDK Eng): Likely a preflight fanout + handshake (ephemeral token) race. v0.9.4 still does independent preflight + token fetch per tab. Two quick asks: which auth flow (ephemeral token via /session or long-lived key)?
Priya (Velvet CS): Ephemeral token via our /session endpoint (short TTL). Each tab requests a new token on load.
Devon (Edge SRE): If OPTIONS are spiking, set Access-Control-Max-Age higher at the origin or edge to reduce preflights. But if every tab immediately fetches a token and then fires POSTs, we still see bursts that hit rate limits. Do you control the /session endpoint?
Priya (Velvet CS): Yes, we own it.
Tara (SDK Eng): Two practical mitigations: 1) enable SDK-side preflight coalescing (experimental flag) so concurrent preflights from same origin are de-duplicated; 2) increase preflight cache TTL and enable connection reuse/persistent HTTP for token endpoint. Example SDK override (client config):
```
// new SDK options (experimental)
const client = new RedwoodSDK({
  preflight_coalesce: true,
  preflight_cache_max_age: 600, // seconds
  keepAlive: true
});
```
This reduces OPTIONS and groups token fetches. Note: preflight_coalesce is experimental in >=0.10.0.
Devon (Edge SRE): On the edge/origin add header on OPTIONS responses: `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600` and ensure your proxy doesn't strip connection keep-alive. Also enable edge caching for OPTIONS for that path. In our Console there's an "Edge preflight cache" toggle (disabled by default for high-security routes) — we can enable it for this customer route if you want.
Priya (Velvet CS): Tried setting Max-Age + keep-alive; still see some 429s. Stack trace shows simultaneous token fetches to /session that return different tokens, then immediate POSTs (~6 concurrent). Could we gate token issuance so a single token is returned for concurrent requests?
Tara (SDK Eng): Server-side token coalescing pattern helps here: detect concurrent requests for a token from same user/session and return the same ephemeral token (short lived) until it ages out. Quick pseudo pattern: cache token in-memory keyed by session id with short TTL and return cached token if present. Example (node):
```
let tokenCache = new Map();
async function getEphemeralToken(userId) {
  const cached = tokenCache.get(userId);
  if (cached && cached.expiry > Date.now()) return cached.token;
  const token = await fetchNewTokenFromAuthService();
  tokenCache.set(userId, { token, expiry: Date.now() + 55*1000 });
  return token;
}
```
This converted multiple concurrent callers into one token issuer. Works great for SPA cold starts.
Devon (Edge SRE): I'll also whitelist the customer IPs for a short warm-up window so backend rate limits don't immediately kick in while they ramp during onboarding. We should log how many distinct token issuances occur per minute.
Alex (CS): Action items:
- Tara: add note to SDK quickstart recommending `preflight_coalesce` + `preflight_cache_max_age` for SPA onboarding (owner: Tara).
- Priya: implement server-side token cache / coalescing (owner: Velvet infra).
- Devon: enable Edge preflight cache for /v1/chat path + temporary IP whitelist (owner: Devon).
I'll follow up tomorrow to see if 429s drop. @edge-bot can you monitor 429 rate for Velvet and alert if >10/min?
edge-bot: Monitoring rule created for service=api.edge, customer=Velvet, alert_threshold=10 429s/min.
Priya (Velvet CS): Quick update: implemented token coalescing on our /session endpoint and enabled Max-Age 600. Dev enabled edge preflight cache and IP warm-up. After these changes, 429s dropped to <1/min during onboarding ramp. Huge help, thanks! :party-parrot:
Alex (CS): Awesome — closing this thread. Please paste postmortem notes into the onboarding playbook and we will add the SDK flag to the quickstart template. :thumbsup:
